patch.description: Current verified state at S448: 56 accepted / 90 held across 73 configurations / 146 faces; V01 Done, V02 In Progress, V03 Backlog. All-seven V02 is blocked only by two remaining Woven output classes: 28 front neckline/collar contour contacts while preserving the continuous base seam, and 28 back sleeve-hem crossings while preserving fixed S370 band-detail positions. S443 found no source-backed view fix under those choices; S447's 13-value in-memory taper matrix also found no viable source candidate. Polo has no current local output blocker per S436, but all 34 Polo faces remain held under the all-seven gate. Keep all acceptance criteria, thresholds, V02-before-V03, legacy DXF, protected exports, and face holds unchanged. No production geometry, view mapping, or acceptance change is authorized by S448. Next action: obtain maintainer authority for a bounded, proposal-only Woven source-design study; any production change requires a separate exact proposal review and approval. Evidence: docs/research/epic17/S448-current-blocker-board-reconciliation/S448-current-blocker-board-reconciliation.md. Historical decision/evidence summary retained: Latest verified tally remains 56 accepted / 90 held across 73 configurations / 146 faces. S381 found no evidence supporting a false Woven back-hem gap. S419 tested a 2–3-arc Polo H locator across 17 options. All 56 Woven and 34 Polo faces remain held. The 0.25 cm threshold for all non-approved eased-seam exceptions remains active. S426's corrected full-label replay reports zero source-label or marker-label overlaps across all 17 exact Polo options. S406's approved Woven collar-over-plackets order remains implemented. The maintainer keeps the Woven body neckline continuous. Preserve all-seven V02, V02-before-V03. Preserve all-seven V02, keep V03 gated.
